description:
Add an emoji reaction to a Slack message as yourself.

Get the message timestamp from get_slack_channel_history (use ts_slack value).
Common reactions: thumbsup, thumbsdown, heart, eyes, white_check_mark, x.

name.description: Emoji name without colons (e.g., thumbsup, heart, eyes)

timestamp.description: Message timestamp to react to — input key is timestamp (not ts or thread_ts). Use ts_slack value from get_slack_channel_history.

name: add_slack_reaction
